messages:
maya: Quick drop 1 small OKR & feedback microcards you can copy into your review doc. Designed for fast fill + manager lines.

tom: Love this. Keep the objective as a single active verb.
lucy: Can we add a one-line risk or blocker field? helps calibration.
maya: yup added. also included a manager 3-line observation template: evidence, effect, suggested next step.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: review window opens in 6 days. Templates here can be pasted into the form.

maya: --- OKR MICROCARD (fill with very short phrases) ---
- Objective (1 line): "Improve onboarding time for new API users by streamlining example flows."
- Key Result A (metric): "Reduce first-week task completion rate time from 3 days to 1.5 days (measured on cohort N)."
- Key Result B (adoption): "Increase tutorial-to-prod conversions from 12% to 22%."
- Risk / blocker (1 line): "Docs backlog + SDK parity could delay rollout by 2 sprints."
- Support ask (1 line): "Need one backend engineer for 3 sprints to complete SDK hooks."

maya: --- SELF-REVIEW SNIPPET (very short) ---
- What I owned: "Led onboarding flow redesign, shipped SDK parity for Python/JS."
- Evidence of impact: "Cut median time-to-first-success by 50% for new signups."
- What I'd tweak next cycle: "Automate tutorial progression metrics; add automated reminders."

maya: --- MANAGER MICRO-OBSERVATION (3 lines to paste) ---
- Evidence: "Delivered SDK parity and updated onboarding playbook; metrics show 50% faster onboarding for new users."
- Effect: "Improved developer activation and reduced support tickets for first-time users."
- Next step: "Partner with growth to run an experiment on tutorial placement; assign 1 PM sprint to track results."

maya: --- SHORT CALIBRATION RUBRIC (one-liners) ---
- Leveling anchor: "Consistently owns end-to-end deliverables with measurable outcomes."
- Scope indicator: "Cross-team coordination and influence on product decisions."
- Growth marker: "Scales impact by mentoring others and codifying processes."

lucy: Also adding a peer ask DM template we used: "Hey @NAME, quick favor 1 could you give 1-2 lines on my clarity during the onboarding rollout? Example: responsiveness and handoff quality. Thanks!"

tom: This will save so much time. I trimmed it into a shareable doc for my reports.
maya: Great 1 tell me if you want a dedicated manager cheat-sheet with example calibration notes.
people-ops-bot: Note: if you want auto-insert templates in the review form, file a small request to people-ops and tag the template id.
